changelog:
✨ Auto route: configurable model aliases (default "hekato-auto") route exactly like "auto", for agents that treat "auto" as their own model switch.
✨ Admin: tier and blacklist models are picked from a list of routable, pool-prefixed models; the routing map shows one source per API key.
✨ 自动路由：可配置模型别名（默认 "hekato-auto"），与 "auto" 路由方式相同，适用于把 "auto" 当作自身模型切换的客户端。
✨ 管理面板：层级和黑名单模型可从可路由的、带账号池前缀的模型列表中选择；路由图中每个 API Key 只显示一个来源。
